bridge_closure.counterfactual_interpretation: If this edge were unavailable, listed saved paths would be invalidated. No alternative route is inferred because the saved A09 artifacts do not include bridge-closure reruns.
bridge_closure.selection_rule: most frequent bridge-flagged edge in saved static A09 route paths; tie-break smallest stable edge_id
bridge_closure.source_graph_status: bridges are UNASSESSED_STRUCTURE in A08; closure is a hypothetical explicit scenario, not observed condition

departure_shift.reason: A09 contains saved routes at registered event/scenario/horizon cases; A08 snapshots are at 6, 12, 24, 48 and 72 hours. No exact +/-1-hour snapshot or rerouted result is present; no interpolation or new route search was performed.

limitations: No real bridge closure or shelter availability observations
allocation values are model estimates under assumed capacities and coarse weak-component screening

shelter_unavailability.capacity_factor: not available in allocation_detail rows; not inferred
shelter_unavailability.counterfactual_interpretation: Withdraw this candidate's saved allocation only; other assignments are not rebalanced. The 100-person shelter capacity and all A10 capacities are assumptions, not verified availability.
shelter_unavailability.selection_rule: shelter category with greatest cumulative saved allocation; tie-break smallest numeric OSM ID
